text.p: The Interacciones brokerage said on Wednesday it has downgraded its rating on Mexican conglomerate Desc SA de CV to hold from buy.

--"We believe that in light of its latest results, the recent and marked increase in the share price is justified, but we think that while the company is trading at its rightful price, there are other conglomerates that are more attractively priced," analyst Robert Hulme wrote in a research report.
--Hulme, who was referring to first-quarter results, said second-quarter results due out soon should mirror Q1, with solid performances from the auto parts and chemical products businesses.
--He said the auto parts division should see sales growth of two percent compared to the first quarter, with an operating margin of 15.5 percent.
--Sales for the chemical products division were seen falling five percent due to the appreciation of the peso, but operating margins should hold firm at 15.5 percent, Hulme said.
--In the food division, "the costs in dollars and a weak domestic demand have damaged the progress that had been achieved in this division since the devaluation," Hulme said.
